name: The Fool
meaning: The first step of something new, taken before you have all the answers. Openness, trust, beginning again.
questions: What would you step towards if you didn't need to be sure first?
What do you want to carry lightly into what comes next?

name: The Magician
meaning: Everything you need is already on the table. The skills you built didn't leave with the role.
questions: Which of your tools have you forgotten you're holding?
What could you begin this week with what you already have?
symbols: cup, sword, coin on a table

name: The High Priestess
meaning: The quiet knowing underneath the noise. Some answers come only when you stop asking out loud.
questions: What do you already know that you haven't said to anyone?
When did you last trust a feeling before you had proof?

name: The Empress
meaning: Growth that comes from care rather than force. Abundance, rest and the body remembered.
questions: What in you is ready to grow now that you've stopped forcing it?
How will you look after yourself in the chapter that's starting?

name: The Emperor
meaning: Structure you choose for yourself. Boundaries, steadiness, a foundation to build on.
questions: What structure would help you feel steady again?
Where do you need a clearer boundary going forward?

name: The Hierophant
meaning: Teachers, traditions and the wisdom handed down. Asking who you learn from, and what you still believe.
questions: Whose voice do you hear when you judge yourself?
Which of the rules you were taught still serve you?

name: The Lovers
meaning: A choice made from your values, not from fear. Alignment between what you want and how you live.
questions: What choice in front of you is really a question about your values?
What matters enough that you'd choose it even if it cost you?

name: The Chariot
meaning: Moving forward with intention, holding opposing pulls together. Direction found.
questions: Which direction feels like yours, not someone else's?
What two parts of you will you need to steer together?

name: Strength
meaning: Quiet courage. Gentleness with the part of you that's frightened or angry.
questions: What part of you needs patience rather than pressure right now?
Where have you been brave this week without anyone seeing it?

name: The Hermit
meaning: Stepping back to find your own light. Solitude chosen, not imposed.
questions: What becomes clearer when you're alone with it?
What light do you carry that you could follow without anyone's permission?

name: Wheel of Fortune
meaning: Cycles turn. What rose can fall and what fell can rise. Much of this was never in your control.
questions: What part of this change was never yours to control?
What cycle in your life keeps coming round, and what is it asking?
symbols: four winged figures in the corners

name: Justice
meaning: An honest accounting. Cause and effect, fairness, telling yourself the truth.
questions: What is the fair story of what happened, neither harsher nor kinder than the truth?
What do you owe yourself after this?

name: The Hanged Man
meaning: A pause you didn't choose. The world looks different upside down, and that view is the gift.
questions: What are you being asked to stop forcing?
What can you see from here that you couldn't see before?

name: Death
meaning: An ending that makes room. Transformation, never literal. Something has finished its season.
questions: What has truly ended, even if part of you is still holding it?
What did this ending make room for that you haven't looked at yet?

name: Temperance
meaning: Blending, patience, finding the middle path. Healing happens in small pourings, not floods.
questions: What would a gentler pace look like this week?
What two parts of your life are you learning to blend?
symbols: one foot on land, one in water
path to a crown of light

name: The Devil
meaning: The chains that are looser than they look. Habits, fears or attachments you can lift off.
questions: What are you still tied to that you could simply take off?
What story about yourself has kept you in place?

name: The Tower
meaning: A sudden fall of something that wasn't built to last. What collapses clears the ground for what's true.
questions: What fell that you were holding up alone?
Now that it's down, what can you see that the tower was hiding?

name: The Star
meaning: Hope after the storm. Renewal, calm water, a light to steer by.
questions: What gives you quiet hope right now, however small?
What would you like to pour back into the world?
symbols: water poured onto land and pool

name: The Moon
meaning: The path at night. Uncertainty, dreams and fears that look larger in the dark.
questions: What fear looks bigger tonight than it will in daylight?
What is your intuition saying beneath the worry?

name: The Sun
meaning: Warmth, clarity and simple joy. Being seen as you are.
questions: What made you feel like yourself again this week?
What would you do more of if you trusted your own joy?

name: Judgement
meaning: A calling heard. Rising into the person this crossing has made you.
questions: What is calling you now that wasn't before?
What would you tell the person you were on the first evening?

name: The World
meaning: Completion. A circle closed, whole and integrated, ready for the next beginning.
questions: What feels complete now?
What are you taking with you into the next circle?

name: Ace of Cups
meaning: A new opening of the heart. Feeling returning, love offered or received.
questions: Where is your heart opening again?
What feeling would you like more room for?

name: Two of Cups
meaning: A connection forming. Mutual recognition, being met.
questions: Who has met you honestly during this time?
What kind of connection do you want to build next?

name: Three of Cups
meaning: Friendship and celebration. The people who'll witness your return.
questions: Who do you want beside you when you return?
What would you like to celebrate, even quietly?

name: Four of Cups
meaning: Turning inward and away. Sometimes rest, sometimes missing what's being offered.
questions: What is being offered that you haven't noticed?
Is this withdrawal rest, or is it avoidance?
symbols: a fourth offered from a cloud

name: Five of Cups
meaning: Grief for what spilled. Two cups still stand behind you.
questions: What are you grieving that deserves to be grieved?
What is still standing, even now?

name: Six of Cups
meaning: Memory and nostalgia. Honouring the past without living in it.
questions: What from the past do you want to thank before you leave it?
What do you miss, and what does that tell you about what you need?

name: Seven of Cups
meaning: Many possibilities, some of them illusions. Choosing needs clear sight.
questions: Which of your options are real, and which are wishes?
If you could only pursue one, which would it be?

name: Eight of Cups
meaning: Walking away from what no longer fills you, even though it took years to build.
questions: What are you walking away from, and what are you walking towards?
What did it cost you to stay as long as you did?

name: Nine of Cups
meaning: Contentment. A wish fulfilled, or the realisation that you have enough.
questions: What do you already have that you once wished for?
What does 'enough' look like for you now?
symbols: nine cups on an arched shelf

name: Ten of Cups
meaning: Emotional homecoming. Belonging, family in whatever form yours takes.
questions: Where do you feel you belong?
Who is home for you?

name: Page of Cups
meaning: A curious, tender feeling surfacing. An unexpected message from the heart.
questions: What surprised you about how you felt this week?
What would you explore if no one judged it?

name: Knight of Cups
meaning: Following the heart's quest. Slow, romantic, led by what moves you.
questions: What is moving you forward right now?
What would it mean to follow your heart one step at a time?

name: Queen of Cups
meaning: Deep compassion, starting with yourself. Holding feeling without drowning in it.
questions: How would you speak to a friend going through this?
What feeling are you ready to hold rather than fix?

name: King of Cups
meaning: Calm on rough water. Emotional maturity you've earned.
questions: What have you learned about staying steady when things move?
How will you hold others' feelings as well as your own?

name: Ace of Swords
meaning: A moment of clarity cutting through confusion. A truth you can name.
questions: What truth became clear today?
What would you say if you said it plainly?

name: Two of Swords
meaning: A stalemate, eyes covered. Avoiding a choice to stay safe.
questions: What decision have you been putting off?
What would you need to know to take the blindfold off?

name: Three of Swords
meaning: Heartbreak, named. Pain that needs acknowledging before it can ease.
questions: What hurt most about this ending?
Who could you tell the truth about the pain to?

name: Four of Swords
meaning: Rest and recovery. Stillness as a necessary part of the journey, not a failure.
questions: What would real rest look like for you this week?
What are you recovering from that you haven't admitted?
symbols: figure at rest on a tomb

name: Five of Swords
meaning: A conflict that cost more than it won. Choosing peace over being right.
questions: What fight are you ready to stop fighting?
What would letting this go give back to you?

name: Six of Swords
meaning: Moving towards calmer water. Leaving the rough shore behind, carrying what you must.
questions: What are you carrying across with you?
What does the calmer shore look like in your mind?

name: Seven of Swords
meaning: Strategy, or slipping away from something. Honesty about what you're avoiding.
questions: Where are you not being fully honest with yourself?
What are you trying to take with you that you should leave?

name: Eight of Swords
meaning: Feeling trapped by walls that have gaps. The way out often starts in the mind.
questions: Which of the walls around you is a belief rather than a fact?
What small step out is open to you?

name: Nine of Swords
meaning: The fears that visit at 3am. Worry is loudest in the dark and rarely tells the whole truth.
questions: What worry keeps you awake, and what is it really about?
What would you say to that fear in daylight?

name: Ten of Swords
meaning: Rock bottom. The worst has happened, and on the horizon the sky is already lightening.
questions: Now that the worst has happened, what is still yours?
What is the first light you can see on the horizon?

name: Page of Swords
meaning: Curiosity and watchfulness. Asking questions, gathering information.
questions: What do you want to understand better before you decide?
Who could you ask a hard question?

name: Knight of Swords
meaning: Charging ahead. Urgency, ambition, and the risk of moving before thinking.
questions: Where are you rushing because stillness feels unbearable?
What deserves your speed, and what deserves your patience?

name: Queen of Swords
meaning: Clear-eyed honesty shaped by experience. Kind, but no longer fooled.
questions: What have your hard experiences taught you to see clearly?
What boundary would you state if you said it kindly and plainly?

name: King of Swords
meaning: Clear judgement and principled decisions. Thinking that serves others.
questions: What principle will guide your next decisions?
How will you use what you now understand?

name: Ace of Wands
meaning: A spark of new energy or idea. The first green shoot.
questions: What idea keeps coming back to you?
Where do you feel energy returning?

name: Two of Wands
meaning: Looking out at the world and planning. Choosing between staying and going.
questions: What would you plan if you trusted it could happen?
What wider world are you looking out at?

name: Three of Wands
meaning: Waiting for the ships to come in. You've sent things out and now you watch the horizon.
questions: What have you already set in motion?
How can you wait without losing heart?

name: Four of Wands
meaning: Homecoming and celebration. A stable place to arrive.
questions: What would a homecoming look like for you?
What milestone deserves to be marked?

name: Five of Wands
meaning: Friction and competing voices. Everyone with a different opinion about your next step.
questions: Whose opinions about your path are loudest right now?
Which voice in the noise is actually yours?

name: Six of Wands
meaning: Recognition and a win. Being seen for what you've done.
questions: What have you done during this crossing that you're proud of?
Who deserves to share this recognition with you?

name: Seven of Wands
meaning: Standing your ground. Defending what matters to you.
questions: What are you no longer willing to give up?
Where do you need to hold your position?

name: Eight of Wands
meaning: Swift movement after stillness. Things begin to happen at once.
questions: What is starting to move?
How will you stay grounded as things speed up?

name: Nine of Wands
meaning: Weary but still standing. Resilience at the edge of what you can carry.
questions: What has kept you going this far?
What support would help you through the last stretch?

name: Ten of Wands
meaning: Carrying too much for too long. The burden you can finally set down.
questions: What were you carrying that was never only yours?
What will you set down now?

name: Page of Wands
meaning: Enthusiasm and a fresh interest. Exploring without needing it to be a career.
questions: What are you curious about right now, just for its own sake?
What would you try if failing at it didn't matter?

name: Knight of Wands
meaning: Restless energy and adventure. The urge to move, change, go.
questions: What is the restlessness in you asking for?
What adventure would be wise, and what would be escape?

name: Queen of Wands
meaning: Warm confidence. Knowing your own light and letting it be seen.
questions: When do you feel most like yourself?
What would you do this week if you were fully confident?

name: King of Wands
meaning: Vision and leadership. Turning energy into direction for yourself and others.
questions: What vision are you ready to lead?
Who could you bring with you?

name: Ace of Pentacles
meaning: A new, practical opening. A seed you can plant, an opportunity with ground under it.
questions: What practical opportunity is in front of you?
What seed would you plant if you knew you'd tend it?

name: Two of Pentacles
meaning: Juggling and balance. Keeping things moving while the ground shifts.
questions: What are you juggling right now?
What could you put down for a while?
symbols: two coins in an infinity loop

name: Three of Pentacles
meaning: Building together. Your skill recognised within a team.
questions: Who would you like to build with next?
What do you bring that a team can't do without?

name: Four of Pentacles
meaning: Holding on tightly to stay safe. Security that has started to feel like a cage.
questions: What are you gripping out of fear of losing it?
What would loosening your hold allow?
symbols: coins under the feet and on the crown

name: Five of Pentacles
meaning: Hardship and feeling left out in the cold. Help is often closer than it looks.
questions: Where do you feel left out right now?
What help have you not yet asked for?

name: Six of Pentacles
meaning: Giving and receiving. Letting yourself be helped without shame.
questions: What help could you receive gracefully?
What can you give, even now?

name: Seven of Pentacles
meaning: Patience before the harvest. Work done, results not yet visible.
questions: What have you planted that hasn't grown yet?
How do you measure progress when nothing seems to be happening?

name: Eight of Pentacles
meaning: Apprenticeship and craft. Getting better through quiet, repeated work.
questions: What skill would you like to deepen during this time?
What small practice could you repeat each day?

name: Nine of Pentacles
meaning: Self-sufficiency. A life you built, enjoyed on your own terms.
questions: What have you built that no one can take from you?
What does independence look like for you now?

name: Ten of Pentacles
meaning: Legacy and lasting foundations. What you'll pass on.
questions: What do you want your work to leave behind?
Which of your roots will you keep close?
symbols: ten coins in a tree of life

name: Page of Pentacles
meaning: A student's eye. Studying something new with patience and care.
questions: What would you like to learn properly?
What first practical step can you take?

name: Knight of Pentacles
meaning: Slow, steady progress. Reliable effort, one furrow at a time.
questions: What steady effort can you commit to?
Where is slow actually the right speed?

name: Queen of Pentacles
meaning: Grounded care. Looking after body, home and the practical things that keep you well.
questions: What practical care do you need right now?
What would make your home feel like a resting place?

name: King of Pentacles
meaning: Stability you've built and can share. Abundance handled wisely.
questions: What foundation are you standing on now?
How will you use what you have to support others?
